strategy.overview: Cosmic Princess builds one multiplied bonus that can be collected repeatedly during the ball. The numbered top lanes light spinner value: lanes 1 and 2 add 400 to the left spinner, lanes 4 and 5 add 400 to the right, and lane 3 lights the alternating 1,000 spinner. Specific five-bank combinations raise Bonus X to 5x, and the upper-left eject pocket collects the current bonus while preserving the multiplier.
strategy.simpleOverview: Collect top lane 3 to light a spinner for 1,000, then complete the five-bank combinations to raise Bonus X toward 5x. Shoot the upper-left eject pocket to collect the current bonus; the base resets to 1,000, but the multiplier remains active for the next build on that ball.
strategy.summary: Take top lane 3 early, then work the five-bank's required combinations. With a strong multiplier and meaningful base bonus, collect at the upper-left pocket and rebuild. The collect resets only the base, so multiple multiplied collections are possible before the ball ends.

quickInfo.name: Preserve Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: The collect resets base bonus but holds the multiplier.

steps.text: Collect top lane 3 to light the alternating spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Complete drops 2 and 4 for 2x, drops 1, 3, and 5 for 3x, drops 1, 2, 4, and 5 for 4x, then all five for 5x.
Build the base bonus with top lanes, standups, drops, and scoring switches.
Shoot the upper-left eject pocket to collect the current bonus with Bonus X; rebuild while the multiplier remains active.

alternatives.title: Spinner-first route
alternatives.when: Use this when the five-bank is rejecting or partly disabled.

steps.text: Collect lanes 1 and 2 to add 400 to the left spinner, or lanes 4 and 5 to add 400 to the right spinner.
Collect lane 3 so both spinners can reach the 1,000 state as the light alternates.
Repeat the safer spinner and take the collect pocket after the base bonus grows.
Finish the required drop combinations until 5x is lit.
Build base bonus toward 19,000 without risking the collect shot too early.
Collect at the eject pocket, then use the held 5x multiplier on the next base-bonus build.

machineSetup: Test all five top lanes, both spinners and their value lamps, the full five-bank and reset, the upper-left eject pocket and kickout, base-bonus lamps, and all Bonus X states.
Confirm the Extra Ball and Special settings and verify that the eject-pocket collect resets the base bonus to 1,000 while retaining the earned multiplier on the same ball.

cautions.issue: The drop combinations are positional, not ordinary full-bank completions.
cautions.response: Follow the lit 2x-through-5x combinations and verify every drop switch; a weak target can make the multiplier sequence appear to skip or stall.
